nodes.name: .dockerignore
nodes.summary: Docker build context exclusion file that prevents node_modules, git history, Tauri sources, sidecar, docs, and environment files from being sent to the Docker daemon during image builds, keeping build context minimal.

nodes.name: docker-compose.yml
nodes.summary: Local development Docker Compose configuration orchestrating five services — PostgreSQL, Redis, MinIO (object storage with bucket init), and LiteLLM — providing the full infrastructure stack for development without the Waggle app container itself.
nodes.languageNotes: LiteLLM service mounts litellm-config.yaml and exposes 13 provider API keys via environment passthrough, guarded by a test (tests/docker-compose-litellm-env.test.ts).

nodes.name: docker-compose.production.yml
nodes.summary: Production Docker Compose configuration deploying the full Waggle Teams stack — the Waggle server (built from Dockerfile), PostgreSQL, Redis, and MinIO — with health-checked dependencies, persistent volumes, and required CORS_ORIGIN enforcement.
nodes.languageNotes: The waggle service uses CORS_ORIGIN with a mandatory :? shell expansion that causes docker compose to fail-fast if the variable is unset, enforcing a hard production safety gate.

nodes.name: Dockerfile
nodes.summary: Three-stage Docker build producing a minimal Node.js 20 Alpine production image: a builder stage compiles all 27 workspace packages and the Vite frontend, a native-builder stage rebuilds native modules (better-sqlite3) with build tools, and the final stage assembles a hardened non-root runtime image exposing port 3333 with health checks and a /data persistence volume.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-stage approach separates dev-dependency-heavy TypeScript compilation, native module compilation (requiring python3/make/g++), and the lean runtime image — avoids shipping build tools and keeps the final layer small.

nodes.name: builder
nodes.summary: First Docker build stage using node:20-alpine that installs all workspace dependencies and runs npm run build:all to compile TypeScript packages and the Vite web frontend.

nodes.name: native-builder
nodes.summary: Second Docker build stage that installs native build tools (python3, make, g++) and rebuilds better-sqlite3 native bindings for the Alpine Linux target.

nodes.name: node
nodes.summary: Final production Docker stage that assembles the minimal runtime image by copying built artifacts from prior stages, running as a non-root waggle user on port 3333, with health check and /data volume for SQLite persistence.
